description: This source file implements classes and functions for matching URL schemes, hosts, and ports, including handling IP addresses, CIDR blocks, and hostname patterns within the 'net' namespace.

classes.name: SchemeHostPortMatcherRule
classes.description: Base class for URL scheme, host, and port matching rules.

classes.name: SchemeHostPortMatcherHostnamePatternRule
classes.description: Rule for matching hostnames against patterns, with optional scheme and port constraints.

classes.name: SchemeHostPortMatcherIPHostRule
classes.description: Rule for matching specific IP address hosts with optional scheme and port.

classes.name: SchemeHostPortMatcherIPBlockRule
classes.description: Rule for matching IP address blocks (CIDR notation) with optional scheme.

methods.name: SchemeHostPortMatcherRule::FromUntrimmedRawString
methods.description: Creates a matcher rule from a raw string, parsing scheme, host, port, IP, or CIDR.

methods.name: SchemeHostPortMatcherHostnamePatternRule::Evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates if a URL matches the hostname pattern, scheme, and port.

methods.name: SchemeHostPortMatcherHostnamePatternRule::ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the hostname pattern rule.

methods.name: SchemeHostPortMatcherHostnamePatternRule::GenerateSuffixMatchingRule
methods.description: Generates a suffix matching rule by prepending '*' if not already present.

methods.name: SchemeHostPortMatcherIPHostRule::Evaluate
methods.description: Checks if a URL matches the IP host rule based on IP address, scheme, and port.

methods.name: SchemeHostPortMatcherIPHostRule::ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the IP host rule.

methods.name: SchemeHostPortMatcherIPBlockRule::Evaluate
methods.description: Checks if a URL's IP address falls within the CIDR block, considering scheme and port.

methods.name: SchemeHostPortMatcherIPBlockRule::ToString
methods.description: Returns the description of the IP block rule.
